gloss: to braid in; to weave in; to plait

definitions.gloss: to braid in; to weave in; to plait into
definitions.explanation: To interweave or braid something into a larger structure, such as braiding hair, weaving fibers, or incorporating elements into a knitted pattern.

examples.japanese: リボンを{髪|かみ}に{編|あ}み{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I braided a ribbon into my hair.

examples.japanese: {色|いろ}とりどりの{糸|いと}を{編|あ}み{込|こ}んで、{美|うつく}しい{模様|もよう}のマフラーを{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I made a scarf with a beautiful pattern by weaving in threads of various colors.

notes:
A compound verb from {編|あ}む (to knit/braid) + {込|こ}む (into). The {込|こ}む component adds the nuance of weaving something thoroughly into or incorporating it deeply. Most commonly used for braiding hair or weaving materials into fabric/crafts.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive — takes a direct object (the thing being braided in).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {髪|かみ}を{編|あ}み{込|こ}む — to braid hair
- {糸|いと}を{編|あ}み{込|こ}む — to weave thread in
- ビーズを{編|あ}み{込|こ}む — to braid beads in
- {編|あ}み{込|こ}みヘア — braided hairstyle

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {編|あ}む — to knit, to braid; the base verb, without the "into" nuance
- {織|お}り{込|こ}む — to weave in; used for weaving fabric, also figuratively for incorporating ideas
- {三|み}つ{編|あ}み — a three-strand braid; a specific braiding style
